# MotionBook

> Catalog of 112 open-source iOS motion, transition and UI libraries, maintained by younatics. The MotionBook iOS app runs 59 of them live. Stats as of 2026-10-25.

Use catalog.json for structured data (schema in schema/catalog.schema.json). Each entry has stars, last push, license, latest tag, install lines (SPM / CocoaPods / Carthage), a live-demo flag and the Xcode version it was last verified with.

## Catalog

- [catalog.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/younatics/MotionBook/master/catalog.json): all libraries, machine-readable
- [catalog.schema.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/younatics/MotionBook/master/schema/catalog.schema.json): JSON Schema
- [README](https://github.com/younatics/MotionBook#readme): the same list for people
- [Web catalog](https://younatics.github.io/MotionBook/): previews and filters
- [MotionBook app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1205163580): live demos on iPhone

## Libraries

### Animation

- [Lottie](https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-ios): Render After Effects animations natively and keep product motion consistent across screens. (27K stars, pushed 2026-10-06; live demo, SPM)
- [Pop](https://github.com/facebookarchive/pop): Classic extensible animation primitives for spring and decay motion in UIKit apps. (20K stars, pushed 2020-01-02; CocoaPods, archived)
- [Spring](https://github.com/MengTo/Spring): A library to simplify iOS animations in Swift. (14K stars, pushed 2023-07-03; live demo, CocoaPods)
- [SkeletonView](https://github.com/Juanpe/SkeletonView): Today almost all apps have async processes, such as Api requests, long running processes, etc. And while the processes are working, usually developers place a loading view to show users that something is going on.SkeletonView has been conceived to address this need, an elegant way to show users that something is happening and also prepare them to which contents he is waiting. (13K stars, pushed 2026-06-23; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [FLAnimatedImage](https://github.com/Flipboard/FLAnimatedImage): FLAnimatedImage is a performant animated GIF engine for iOS: 1. Plays multiple GIFs simultaneously with a playback speed comparable to desktop browsers 2. Honors variable frame delays 3. Behaves gracefully under memory pressure 4. Eliminates delays or blocking during the first playback loop 5. Interprets the frame delays of fast GIFs the same way modern browsers do (7.9K stars, pushed 2024-03-21; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods)
- [ViewAnimator](https://github.com/marcosgriselli/ViewAnimator): Animate collection and table view content with concise, reusable item animations. (7.3K stars, pushed 2024-03-31; live demo, SPM)
- [Macaw](https://github.com/exyte/Macaw): Powerful and easy-to-use vector graphics Swift library with SVG support (6.0K stars, pushed 2024-02-07; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [ScrollableGraphView](https://github.com/philackm/ScrollableGraphView): An adaptive scrollable graph view for iOS to visualise simple discrete datasets. Written in Swift. (5.3K stars, pushed 2020-12-02; CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive)
- [Advance](https://github.com/timdonnelly/Advance): A physics-based animation framework for direct manipulation, gestures, and playful interface motion. (4.5K stars, pushed 2022-05-16; SPM, archived)
- [Pow](https://github.com/EmergeTools/Pow): Delightful SwiftUI effects for your app (4.4K stars, pushed 2026-04-13; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [Pastel](https://github.com/cruisediary/Pastel): 🎨Gradient animation effect like Instagram (3.5K stars, pushed 2026-03-24; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [Gifu](https://github.com/kaishin/Gifu): Animated GIF playback for UIImageView with frame caching and memory control. (3.2K stars, pushed 2025-08-17; SPM)
- [Stellar](https://github.com/AugustRush/Stellar): A fantastic Physical animation library for swift(Not Just Spring !!!), it is base on UIDynamic and extension to it, friendly APIs make you use it or custom your own animation very easily! (2.9K stars, pushed 2019-07-31; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive)
- [paper-switch](https://github.com/Ramotion/paper-switch): RAMPaperSwitch is a Swift material design UI module which paints over the parent view when the switch is turned on. (2.9K stars, pushed 2022-01-25; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [ConfettiSwiftUI](https://github.com/simibac/ConfettiSwiftUI): SwiftUI Package for Configurable Confetti Animation 🎉 (2.5K stars, pushed 2026-01-05; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [Wave](https://github.com/jtrivedi/Wave): Wave is a spring-based animation engine for iOS and macOS that makes it easy to create fluid, interruptible animations that feel great. (2.4K stars, pushed 2026-03-25; live demo, SPM)
- [RQShineLabel](https://github.com/zipme/RQShineLabel): A UILabel subclass that lets you animate text similar to Secret app. (1.9K stars, pushed 2023-12-25; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods)
- [YLGIFImage](https://github.com/liyong03/YLGIFImage): Asynchronized GIF image class and Image viewer supporting play/stop GIF images. It just use very less memory. Following GIF usually will cost almost 600MB memory if it is fully decoded (800x600x389x4 Bytes), but using YLGIFImage, it just use about 30MB memory. (1.8K stars, pushed 2020-12-19; CocoaPods, inactive)
- [AnimatedMaskLabel](https://github.com/jogendra/LoadingShimmer): Nice gradient animated label that enable an easy way to add a shimmering effect (1.6K stars, pushed 2022-10-22; CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [Vortex](https://github.com/twostraws/Vortex): High-performance particle effects for SwiftUI. (1.6K stars, pushed 2026-04-03; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [Motion (b3ll)](https://github.com/b3ll/Motion): Animation engine for gesturally-driven user interfaces, animations, and interactions on iOS, macOS, and tvOS. (1.5K stars, pushed 2024-10-19; live demo, SPM)
- [Ease](https://github.com/roberthein/Ease): Ease is a event driven animation system that combines the observer pattern with custom spring animations as observers. (1.3K stars, pushed 2020-07-14; SPM, CocoaPods, inactive)
- [RevealingSplashView](https://github.com/PiXeL16/RevealingSplashView): A Splash view that animates and reveals its content, inspired by Twitter splash (1.2K stars, pushed 2025-03-30; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [GlitchLabel](https://github.com/kciter/GlitchLabel): G..lit...c...hing UILa..bel fo..r iO...S (1.0K stars, pushed 2022-12-23; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [Windless](https://github.com/ParkGwangBeom/Windless): Windless makes it easy to implement invisible layout loading view. (947 stars, pushed 2022-07-14; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [Highlighter](https://github.com/younatics/Highlighter): 🖍Highlight whatever you want! Highlighter will magically find UI objects such as UILabel, UITextView, UITexTfield, UIButton in your UITableViewCell or other Class. (921 stars, pushed 2026-10-24; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [Liquid](https://github.com/maustinstar/liquid): Create a playful backsplash in SwiftUI. (856 stars, pushed 2024-08-19; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [rive-ios](https://github.com/rive-app/rive-ios): iOS runtime for Rive (851 stars, pushed 2026-10-24; live demo, SPM)
- [URWeatherView](https://github.com/Urtaq/URWeatherView): Show the weather effects onto view written in Swift3 (447 stars, pushed 2019-01-07; CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive)
- [AnimateText](https://github.com/jasudev/AnimateText): This library for animating text. Developed with SwiftUI. This library supports iOS/macOS. (432 stars, pushed 2024-02-13; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [Gecco](https://github.com/xai3/Gecco): Simply highlight items for your tutorial walkthrough, written in Swift. Gecco means Moonlight in Japanese. (19 stars, pushed 2020-09-16; CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive)

### Transition

- [Hero](https://github.com/HeroTransitions/Hero): Hero is a library for building iOS view controller transitions. It provides a layer on top of the UIKit's cumbersome transition APIs. Making custom transitions an easy task for developers. (22K stars, pushed 2025-01-23; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [XLPagerTabStrip](https://github.com/xmartlabs/XLPagerTabStrip): XLPagerTabStrip is a Container View Controller that allows us to switch easily among a collection of view controllers. Pan gesture can be used to move on to next or previous view controller. It shows a interactive indicator of the current, previous, next child view controllers. (7.0K stars, pushed 2023-11-22; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [AnimatedCollectionViewLayout](https://github.com/KelvinJin/AnimatedCollectionViewLayout): Animated UIButton of Loading Animation and Transition Animation. (4.9K stars, pushed 2020-09-20; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, inactive)
- [Gemini](https://github.com/shoheiyokoyama/Gemini): Gemini is rich scroll based animation framework for iOS, written in Swift. (3.3K stars, pushed 2025-06-28; CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [BubbleTransition](https://github.com/andreamazz/BubbleTransition): A custom modal transition that presents and dismiss a controller inside an expanding and shrinking bubble. (3.3K stars, pushed 2020-11-04; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive)
- [BWWalkthrough](https://github.com/ariok/BWWalkthrough): BWWalkthrough (BWWT) is a class that helps you create Walkthroughs for your iOS Apps. It differs from other similar classes in that there is no rigid template; BWWT is just a layer placed over your controllers that gives you complete freedom on the design of your views. (2.7K stars, pushed 2021-02-07; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [SPStorkController](https://github.com/ivanvorobei/SPStorkController): Apple Music style modal presentation: a card that slides up and can be dragged down to dismiss. (2.7K stars, pushed 2023-01-31; SPM)
- [Transition](https://github.com/Touchwonders/Transition): Interactive, interruptible view controller transitions built from reusable animation and interaction pieces. (2.6K stars, pushed 2020-11-02; SPM, inactive)
- [AnimatedTransitionGallery](https://github.com/shu223/AnimatedTransitionGallery): Collection of custom animated transitions for iOS using UIViewControllerAnimatedTransitioning protocol. (2.5K stars, pushed 2024-04-30; manual install)
- [Jelly](https://github.com/SebastianBoldt/Jelly): Animated view controller presentations (slide, fade, shift), interactive or not, in a few lines. (2.5K stars, pushed 2025-11-28; SPM)
- [AMWaveTransition](https://github.com/andreamazz/AMWaveTransition): Custom transition between viewcontrollers holding tableviews. Each cell is animated to simulate a 'wave effect'. (2.3K stars, pushed 2020-06-07; CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive)
- [TKSubmitTransition](https://github.com/takuoka/TKSubmitTransition): Animated UIButton of Loading Animation and Transition Animation. (2.3K stars, pushed 2019-12-04; CocoaPods, inactive)
- [ElasticTransition](https://github.com/lkzhao/ElasticTransition): A UIKit custom transition that simulates an elastic drag. Written in Swift. (2.2K stars, pushed 2020-05-10; CocoaPods, inactive)
- [preview-transition](https://github.com/Ramotion/preview-transition): PreviewTransition is a simple preview gallery controller (2.1K stars, pushed 2020-04-06; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive)
- [PinterestSwift](https://github.com/demonnico/PinterestSwift): This is a Swift based demo project to show how to make the transition Pinterest liked. (1.9K stars, pushed 2020-06-15; inactive)
- [CKWaveCollectionViewTransition](https://github.com/CezaryKopacz/CKWaveCollectionViewTransition): Cool wave like transition between two or more UICollectionView (1.8K stars, pushed 2019-10-13; CocoaPods, inactive)
- [Motion](https://github.com/CosmicMind/Motion): A Material-inspired motion engine for transitions, transforms, and interactive presentation work. (1.8K stars, pushed 2020-01-28; SPM, inactive)
- [Transmission](https://github.com/nathantannar4/Transmission): Bridges UIKit presentation APIs to a SwiftUI API so you can use presentation controllers, interactive transitions and more. (1.2K stars, pushed 2026-10-24; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [JTMaterialTransition](https://github.com/johnvuko/JTMaterialTransition): An iOS transition for controllers based on material design. (949 stars, pushed 2019-01-17; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, inactive)

New morphing effects are available as Swift extensions. (8.1K stars, pushed 2026-03-08; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)

- [MarkdownView](https://github.com/keitaoouchi/MarkdownView): MarkdownView is a WKWebView based UI element, and internally use bootstrap, highlight.js, markdown-it. (2.2K stars, pushed 2026-10-22; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [Glur](https://github.com/joogps/Glur): A library for progressive blurs in SwiftUI. (2.1K stars, pushed 2026-10-18; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [fluid-slider](https://github.com/Ramotion/fluid-slider): A slider widget with a popup bubble displaying the precise value selected. (2.0K stars, pushed 2022-06-01; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [SwiftUI-Shimmer](https://github.com/markiv/SwiftUI-Shimmer): Shimmer is a super-light modifier that adds a shimmering effect to any SwiftUI View, for example, to show that an operation is in progress. It works well on light and dark modes, and across iOS, macOS, tvOS, watchOS and visionOS. (1.7K stars, pushed 2024-08-14; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [ScalingHeaderScrollView](https://github.com/exyte/ScalingHeaderScrollView): A scroll view with a sticky header which shrinks as you scroll. Written with SwiftUI. (1.5K stars, pushed 2026-10-20; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [YNSearch](https://github.com/younatics/YNSearch): ✨Awesome search view, written in Swift 3, appears search view like Pinterest Search view. You can fully customize this library. You can also use this library with Realm! (1.2K stars, pushed 2026-10-24; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)
- [Shiny](https://github.com/maustinstar/shiny): Shiny uses your gyroscope to simulate lighting and motion effects on colors. Works on almost every SwiftUI View. (1.1K stars, pushed 2024-07-12; live demo, SwiftUI, SPM)
- [AIFlatSwitch](https://github.com/cocoatoucher/AIFlatSwitch): A smooth, nice looking and IBDesignable flat design switch for iOS. Can be used instead of UISwitch. Inspired by Creativedash's Dribbble post (963 stars, pushed 2022-06-06; SPM, CocoaPods)
- [MediaBrowser](https://github.com/younatics/MediaBrowser): 🏞 MediaBrowser can display one or more images or videos by providing either UIImage objects, PHAsset objects, or URLs to library assets, web images/videos or local files. MediaBrowser handles the downloading and caching of photos from the web seamlessly. Photos can be zoomed and panned, and optional (customisable) captions can be displayed. This can also be used to allow the user to select one or more photos using either the grid or main image view. (646 stars, pushed 2026-10-24; live demo, SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage)

- [BusyNavigationBar](https://github.com/gmertk/BusyNavigationBar): A UINavigationBar extension to show loading effects above navigation bar's background. (980 stars, pushed 2017-05-01; CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive)
- [SpringIndicator](https://github.com/KyoheiG3/SpringIndicator): SpringIndicator is indicator and PullToRefresh. Inspired by Material design components. (271 stars, pushed 2020-09-21; SPM, CocoaPods, Carthage, inactive)
